requirements.unchanged_MLP_from_scratch: All 145 audited initializations and paired base batch hashes verified by cohort reports.

requirements.alternative_regularizers: Four objectives across ten development and five fresh sources; scalar adaptations stated explicitly.
requirements.fresh_source_validation: Five 600-update ICM sources; coefficient 100 fixed before generation; 25 encoder fits verified.
requirements.controls: Local coefficient 1, local coefficient 100, global coefficients 1/10/100; adaptive decisions retained.
requirements.prediction: Independent checkpoint recomputation of held-out and coverage-stress decoder errors for all 145 fits.
requirements.geometry: Independent 20001-point derivative checks for all 145 fits; any versus material folds separately reported.
requirements.artifacts: Ten PNG/PDF figure pairs; all ten PNGs visually reviewed; gallery and repository links checked.
requirements.limitations: No hard guarantee; one substantial mining failure; deterministic scalar simulator; compute and nuisance limits explicit.
